goal: Prevent CMake configuration errors when building against external libmultiprocess versions that drop example targets
Keeps builds and CI working for non-subtree libmultiprocess integrations, including libmultiprocess's own CI
reviewability: Stale: author silent 100+ days with an unresolved design disagreement about where the fix belongs
Review invites weighing hebasto's alternative approach, but no rebase or CI blocker prevents reviewing now
agreement: Concept ACK but with a differing design preference for fixing this upstream instead (hebasto)
Nonblocking objection: cross-project CMake coupling forces parent projects to process unused code (hebasto)
Author disputed the alternative citing added fragility, discussion stalled without consensus (ryanofsky)

categories.name: build
why: P4 because the fix only helps custom builds with an external libmultiprocess, not the subtree build most users and CI rely on
Underlying cause is an unmerged upstream fix in libmultiprocess#287, and discussion suggests the cleaner fix belongs there
Marginal impact since it is a small defensive guard rather than something most developers will ever hit
